title: Inverse-Limit Formulas and Stable-Range Rigidity for Cyclotomic Sums
summary: We study truncation compatible families F = (F_m)_{m>=1} over Q[z] through an inverse limit formalism, and we evaluate them at the punctured cyclotomic cosine points alpha_{k,n} = cos(2 pi k/n) with the specialization z equals n-1. For symmetric families of uniformly bounded total degree in x = d+2, the cosine point evaluation factors through the finitely many punctured cosine power sums the finitely many power sums P1(n) through Pd(n).
